content.short: Virtuals Protocol is a Base-native platform for creating and co-owning autonomous AI agents with fractional tokens.
content.description:
Virtuals Protocol is a pioneering decentralized ecosystem built on the Base network, designed to facilitate the creation, co-ownership, and management of autonomous AI agents. The platform features a unique "fractionalized agent" model, where every AI persona—capable of interacting across X, Roblox, and TikTok—has its own 1 billion supply token launched on a bonding curve. This allows community members to gain governance rights and a share in the agent's revenue, fostering a more meritocratic and collaborative AI economy.

Powered by the VIRTUAL token and its proprietary G.A.M.E. Engine, the protocol ensures that agents maintain a consistent persona and long-term memory across different digital environments. Virtuals Protocol serves as a foundational infrastructure for the "Agentic Web," providing the tools needed for developers and creators to launch sophisticated decentralized intelligence. Through its commitment to user sovereignty and technological innovation, Virtuals Protocol is building the essential framework for a more secure and rewarding digital future, where AI agents are recognized as globally accessible and community-governed assets.
content.meta: Virtuals Protocol provides a decentralized platform for creating, tokenizing, and co-owning autonomous AI agents on Base.
